wholeCurrentGoal.title: Proteine und Genwirkketten für Merkmale erklären
wholeCurrentGoal.titleEn: Explain Proteins and Gene Chains for Trait Expression
wholeCurrentGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Aufgaben von Proteinen sowie das Zusammenwirken von Genen in einer Genwirkkette bei der Ausbildung von Merkmalen erläutern und Auswirkungen einer Unterbrechung der Genwirkkette erklären.
wholeCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can explain protein functions and gene interactions in a gene chain during trait expression and explain effects of interrupting such a gene chain.

perRasterJudgments.format: opaque PNG comic schematic educational style

scientificAndGeometricJudgments.mechanism: GenA→E1 catalyses S→I, GenB→E2 catalyses I→P. The defective-B row removes E2 and the product, while supplying I cannot replace the missing second enzyme. Large I ersetzt kein E2 states the actual causal boundary; the arrows terminate on I and the blocked I→P step.
scientificAndGeometricJudgments.geometry: Two coherent horizontal rows, clear gene→enzyme versus substrate→product arrows, no false direct gene→pigment jump. S/I stay colourless and P is blue.
scientificAndGeometricJudgments.phone: At360 the critical I ersetzt kein E2, interruption statement and E1/E2/S/I/P remain identifiable;680 is clear.
scientificAndGeometricJudgments.scope: One constructed enzyme/gene-chain example supports protein function and interruption, not a universal claim that all genes produce flower pigments.

wholeCurrentGoal.title: Genaktivität für Zelldifferenzierung und Anpassung erklären
wholeCurrentGoal.titleEn: Explain Gene Activity for Cell Differentiation and Adaptation
wholeCurrentGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Mechanismen der Regulation der Genaktivität beschreiben und damit erklären, wie Zellen trotz gleicher genetischer Ausstattung unterschiedliche Eigenschaften aufweisen, sich an Umweltbedingungen anpassen und lebendige Systeme entwickeln und spezialisieren können.
wholeCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can describe mechanisms of gene activity regulation and use them to explain how cells with the same genetic information develop different properties, adapt to environmental conditions, and enable development and specialization in living systems.

perRasterJudgments.format: opaque PNG comic schematic educational style

scientificAndGeometricJudgments.mechanism: The same DNA and one model gene yield contrasting transcript/protein quantities in two schematic cells. TF contacts accessible chromatin; the other transcription arrow is crossed, and a signal points to regulation. A compact gene is pictured within nucleosome organisation rather than a changed DNA sequence.
scientificAndGeometricJudgments.geometry: Both chromatin depictions retain two intertwined DNA backbones and nucleosomes. The open versus close arrangement and the green TF are distinguishable. One-gen model note avoids all genes being on or off.
scientificAndGeometricJudgments.phone: TF and its full Transkriptionsfaktor expansion are large and readable at360; same DNA, signal, much/little protein and open/dense chromatin can be followed.
scientificAndGeometricJudgments.scope: A model regulation example, not evidence that neurons/muscles differ in all genes or that one gene alone proves complete specialization.

wholeCurrentGoal.title: DNA-Replikation, PCR und Reparaturenzyme vergleichen
wholeCurrentGoal.titleEn: Compare DNA Replication, PCR, and Repair Enzymes
wholeCurrentGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann den natürlichen Prozess der DNA-Replikation mit der PCR vergleichen, Probleme und Lösungen technischer Umsetzung natürlicher Prozesse erklären und die Bedeutung von Reparaturenzymen bei der natürlichen DNA-Replikation beschreiben.
wholeCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can compare natural DNA replication with PCR, explain problems and solutions in technically implementing natural processes, and describe the importance of repair enzymes in natural DNA replication.

perRasterJudgments.format: opaque PNG comic schematic educational style

scientificAndGeometricJudgments.mechanism: Upper fork synthesis points towards the left-hand fork and lower synthesis away in segments. PCR opposing primer arrows face inward at opposite terminal sites, supplied95/55/72 cycles lead to copying. The right sequence depicts removal, template-supported insertion and completed duplex rather than PCR as repair.
scientificAndGeometricJudgments.geometry: Two backbones and connecting base rungs form each duplex. Opposed replication arrows and opposite PCR arrows remain visibly different; the repair opposite strand remains continuous across the gapped upper strand. No3prime/5prime end labels are invented.
scientificAndGeometricJudgments.phone: Helikase/Polymerase, three process headings and all supplied temperatures remain readable at360. The three mechanistic panels and arrows remain separable.
scientificAndGeometricJudgments.scope: Schematic local duplex/base repair comparison, not a real laboratory protocol, a complete molecular replication fork or an all-errors repair promise.

wholeCurrentGoal.title: Meiose geschlechtsspezifisch erklären
wholeCurrentGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann den Ablauf der Meiose bei unterschiedlichen Geschlechtern beschreiben und ihre Bedeutung für die geschlechtliche Fortpflanzung erklären.
wholeCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can describe the process of meiosis in different sexes and explain its importance for sexual reproduction.

perRasterJudgments.format: opaque PNG comic schematic educational style

scientificAndGeometricJudgments.mechanism: Homologs separate inI, sister chromatids inII. Both start with one replicated blue/red homolog pair; sperm branch ends in4 haploid products, egg branch inone large blue product plus3 small polar bodies. Two blue/two red chromatids are conserved separately in both branches.
scientificAndGeometricJudgments.geometry: All four product arrows connect correct predecessor chromatids; bracket for polar bodies includes only3 small products and excludes the large egg. Middle-cell icon diameters are schematic rather than a quantitative cytoplasmic-volume model.
scientificAndGeometricJudgments.phone: Large Meiose,2n,n, I Homologe trennen,II Chromatiden trennen,Spermien,Eizelle,Polkörper remain legible at360.
scientificAndGeometricJudgments.scope: One-homolog-pair schema with a3-polar-body example. It does not show chromosome number for a complete human karyotype or guarantee every first polar body divides.

wholeCurrentGoal.title: Genetische Neukombination und Biodiversität verknüpfen
wholeCurrentGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann den Zusammenhang zwischen genetischen Neukombinationsprozessen und der Evolution bisheriger sowie zukünftiger Biodiversität erklären.
wholeCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can explain the relationship between genetic recombination processes and the evolution of past and future biodiversity.

perRasterJudgments.format: opaque PNG comic schematic educational style

scientificAndGeometricJudgments.mechanism: The output parental and recombinant columns conserve the original upper/lower marker pairs, and the population→generations/inheritance/selection→possible diversity text provides a bounded evolutionary bridge. The displayed central crossover stage fails conservation of the lower-locus markers.
scientificAndGeometricJudgments.geometry: Input lower markers are green,green,gold,gold. Central four rods show green,gold,gold,gold even though the inner lower arms already show a reciprocal colour swap. The inner blue-upper/red-distal rod retains a gold lower marker instead of the transferred green one. Outputs return to green,gold,gold,green; the central stage invents one gold allele and loses one green marker.
scientificAndGeometricJudgments.phone: Large parent/recombination/population/generation/diversity labels are readable at360. Better legibility does not remove the actual marker-conservation defect.
scientificAndGeometricJudgments.scope: No instant-species claim; the new same-population/generation bridge is appropriately qualified. The allele-tracking defect still blocks this selected actual raster.

wholeCurrentGoal.title: Genommutationen aus Karyogrammen ableiten
wholeCurrentGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann aus Karyogrammen verschiedene Typen von Genommutationen ableiten, deren Auswirkungen auf verschiedenen Organisationsebenen beschreiben und zwischen Genotypänderung, Phänotypänderung und Krankheit unterscheiden.
wholeCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can derive different types of genome mutations from karyograms, describe their effects on different organizational levels, and distinguish genotype changes, phenotype changes, and disease.

perRasterJudgments.format: opaque PNG comic schematic educational style

scientificAndGeometricJudgments.mechanism: Upper example changes one chromosome type from2 to3; lower complete3-type model changes every type2→3, distinguishing trisomy from triploidy. Gene dosage→cell→organ→organism and dotted arrows to a disease question keep biological effects separate from automatic illness.
scientificAndGeometricJudgments.geometry: Actual top counts2/3 and actual lower type counts2,2,2 versus3,3,3 agree with2n/3n. Continuous stylized chromosomes have one constriction each, not wrongly paired X chromatids.
scientificAndGeometricJudgments.phone: The one-type versus all-types headings and2/3 copy counts plus2n/3n and disease question remain identifiable at360;680 permits all chain labels to be read comfortably.
scientificAndGeometricJudgments.scope: A finite3-type schematic, not a full human karyogram or clinical diagnostic/phenotype proof.

findings.actual: The lower marker on the inner blue-upper/red-distal chromatid is gold rather than green. Together with the other three rods this central stage has one green and three gold lower markers; before and after it there are two of each.
findings.expected: A reciprocal distal exchange conserves allele markers: central already exchanged chromatids must carry green,gold,green,gold in left-to-right order. The transferred green lower-locus marker should accompany the red distal arm on the inner blue chromatid.
findings.neededTargetedRemedy: Correct that actual central lower marker; preserve other unchanged marker/rod/outcome geometry and the bounded population/generations bridge. Then re-inspect the selected original360680 and exact metadata/native bindings.

nonblockingSchematicLimit14: The same-sized intermediate cell icons are not literal first meiotic cytoplasmic volumes. The large final egg versus3small polar bodies and correct lineages make the chromosome-separation example assessable; no quantitative-volume claim is approved.
